'''Shark Zone''' was an arcade in the [[peacekeeping zone]] on the [[planet]] [[Plazir-15]]. A [[Color|red]] and white [[Hologram|holographic]] sign over the entrance stated the business' name in [[Aurebesh]], accompanied by a picture of a [[shark]]. The name was accompanied by three words written in smaller characters, one of them being "[[Foodstuff|FOOD]]". The word "ARCADE" was painted over the entrance.<ref name="Chapter 22" />
